Class HL7DTM

java.lang.Object
org.openehealth.ipf.commons.ihe.core.HL7DTM
public class HL7DTM extends Object
HL7 timestamps (data type DTM) with particular precision, normalized to UTC. It's the usual date format used by IHE.
Since:
4.1
Author:

  • Method Details

    • toZonedDateTime

      public static ZonedDateTime toZonedDateTime(String s) throws DataTypeException
      Creates a ZonedDateTime object from the given string.
      Parameters:
      s - String of the pattern YYYY[MM[DD[HH[MM[SS[.S[S[S[S]]]]]]]]][+/-ZZZZ]. Milliseconds will be ignored.
      Returns:
      a ZonedDateTime object, or null if the parameter is null or empty.
      Throws:
      DataTypeException - if the DTM string is invalid.

    • toSimpleString

      Creates a simple DTM representation of a TemporalAccessor.
      Parameters:
      temporalAccessor - The TemporalAccessor to convert (e.g. Instant, ZonedDateTime).
      Returns:
      a string, or null if the parameter is null.
